nodes.name: Docling
nodes.summary: Native-document conversion dependency used with OCR and model enrichments disabled.

nodes.name: PDF Inspector
nodes.summary: Native PDF inspection dependency for selectable text, layout, tables, and positions.

nodes.name: LangExtract
nodes.summary: Schema-guided extraction dependency whose candidates require exact source grounding.

nodes.name: GLM-OCR
nodes.summary: Local OCR service retained for scanned documents and OCR-selected mixed pages.

nodes.name: PaddleOCR-VL
nodes.summary: Local OCR service retained for scanned documents and OCR-selected mixed pages.

nodes.name: A native format has one validated parser path
nodes.summary: A new format must map to an explicit processing type, validate its content, construct source units and spans, and enter exactly one native parser path.

nodes.name: Routing correctness is distinct from extraction quality
nodes.summary: Native evaluation must test selected pipeline routing separately from exact source-grounded extraction quality.

nodes.name: Selected mode never bypasses validation
nodes.summary: User selection does not authorize silent reinterpretation; content validation and bounded evidence contracts still apply.

nodes.name: Presentation never becomes extraction evidence
nodes.summary: Rendered Markdown and source-structure views are downstream presentations and must not replace immutable base text for extraction.

nodes.name: Ungrounded extraction candidates are rejected
nodes.summary: Candidates lacking a valid interval, exact substring match, full span coverage, or resolvable source evidence are not accepted.

nodes.name: The native model validates its grounding
nodes.summary: NativeDocument enforces bounded ordered ranges, base-text spans, and resolvable declared source anchors.

nodes.name: Native dependencies remain non-OCR
nodes.summary: PDF Inspector, Docling, and LangExtract do not replace local OCR ownership for scanned and OCR-selected pages.

edges.description: The article states the complete required path for adding a native format.
Docling is the concrete conversion adapter discussed for a new native format.
The article explicitly separates route expectations from grounded extraction checks.
The article describes untrusted uploads and rejects silent interpretation by another pipeline.
The article makes immutable base text the stable coordinate system and excludes rendered views from extraction input.
The article lists the required interval, exact-match, coverage, and anchor checks.
LangExtract is the extraction component constrained by the grounding checks.
The article describes the model's range, span, and anchor validation invariants.
The article preserves OCR ownership for the local OCR services while native dependencies remain non-OCR.
GLM-OCR is named as a retained local OCR service.
PaddleOCR-VL is named as a retained local OCR service.
The trust-boundary article applies LangExtract's interval and span-resolution contract as a security boundary.
